facts.fact: The APDP fined the Clinique médicale Koulakou in Bamako 5,000,000 F CFA for obstructing an on-site check of CCTV it had installed illegally; the post is dated 2025-08-06 and gives no decision date.
The APDP imposed an administrative fine on a named clinic, acting as a functioning regulator with on-site inspection powers (post dated 2025-08-06).
